name: Addle
description:
You project frightening sounds or words you choose into a creature's mind.

Roll Awe vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. On a win, the creature checks a Condition and immediately spends a reaction (if available) to move away from you, moving half its speed. On a loss, it just checks a Condition.

Describe the sounds or words.
successes:
✨: The creature checks an additional Condition.

🌞: The creature checks an additional Condition, rolls Injury, and it cannot uncheck the Conditions checked by this ability while it can see you.
